items.stem: The second law of thermodynamics implies that:

options.text: The total entropy of an isolated system never decreases
options.rationale: Correct: entropy of an isolated system stays the same (reversible) or increases (irreversible).

options.text: Energy is destroyed in every real process
options.rationale: Energy is conserved; the first law forbids its destruction.

options.text: Heat flows spontaneously from cold to hot
options.rationale: Spontaneous heat flow is from hot to cold.

items.explanation: Correct: entropy of an isolated system stays the same (reversible) or increases (irreversible).
